csv_project_name: On-Call Design & Install Rapid-Build Str-Emerg Preparedness
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Orange, County Executive Office - CPO (hereinafter referred to as County ), is soliciting proposals from qualified firms (hereinafter referred to as Respondents ) for The County is seeking qualified contractors to provide the design, manufacture, delivery, and installation of Rapid-Build Tensioned Membrane Aluminum Frame Structures (TMS) to support emergency preparedness and response operations. Services include engineering and code-compliant design, fabrication of modular structural systems, transportation to County-designated sites, full installation and assembly, and training for County personnel on operation and maintenance. The structures must be durable, rapidly deployable, and capable of withstanding extreme environmental conditions while supporting flexible, temporary or semi-permanent use..
